overview.description: Elimination Blackjack is a commercial blackjack tournament format combining dealer play with periodic player elimination.

history.origins: Invented by Russ Hamilton and used on the Ultimate Blackjack Tour, Elimination Blackjack adds no-limit tournament pressure and scheduled eliminations to blackjack.
timeline: Documented card-play form: Elimination Blackjack is described as a distinct game with its own rules.

setup.dealing: Players sit at a blackjack tournament table with chip stacks and play hands against the dealer.

rules.objective: Survive elimination hands and finish with the strongest chip position.
rules.gameplay: Each hand plays as blackjack against the dealer, but betting order, chip stacks, and scheduled elimination points determine which players remain in the tournament.
keyRules: Players still play against the dealer.

strategy.basic: Bet relative to opponents stacks, not just the dealer upcard; survival thresholds matter more than single-hand expectation.
